name: Grand ballroom
desc: Formal display: entrances, dances, and everything that has to be said in front of witnesses.
tags: grand ballroom, crystal chandeliers, polished parquet floor, gilded columns, tall arched mirrors, red velvet curtains, balcony running above, painted ceiling, candelabra, sweeping marble staircase, orchestra at the far end
prose: a grand ballroom with crystal chandeliers hung above a polished parquet floor, gilded columns and tall mirrors down the walls, a balcony running around above and a sweeping staircase at one end
note: Opulent, grand and luxurious all land you in the same beige hotel function room. Four nouns actually build it: chandeliers, parquet, mirrors and the balcony overhead - add the staircase only when someone has to make an entrance. Dancers smear into faceless blobs, so keep any crowd at mid-ground or beyond and do not write a beat that needs a readable extra.
